samples.question: The chart shows five colored bars standing on one common baseline: red, orange, green, blue and purple, in some left-to-right order. The horizontal gray gridlines are exactly one unit apart, so a bar's value is its height measured in gridline units above the baseline. Bar widths, bar positions and the left-to-right order carry no information. The dashed black rule marks a target level, measured in those same gridline units above the baseline. Exactly one pair of bars has values that add up exactly to the target level, and every other pair of bars misses it. Which two colors are that pair? Answer with the two color names joined by " and ", in alphabetical order, for example "blue and red".
